Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
To get started, Eternity® flowers require almost no effort. Keep them in a room-temperature environment, avoid watering them, and keep them out of direct sunlight and high humidity.
Do not remove the florals from their box or vase, as they are securely set to remain vibrant for up to a year. If dust collects over time, simply dust them lightly with a soft duster.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
ime?
menu
To display and care for your Le Mini Round arrangement properly from day one, simply unbox it carefully and keep the rose inside its signature round Parisian-hat box, as removing the bloom will damage it.
Place the box in a room-temperature environment, keeping it away from direct sunlight, excess humidity, and water. Keep the lid on the side or bottom of the box, and avoid touching or placing anything on top of the petals.
